Approved Date: 15 Sep 2008

مقدمة

This document outlines the minor maintenance 
procedures P1, 
which must performed every 8000 equivalent operating hours as indicated by H8000 in the above title block

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. 
Elmetwaly Dawoud, accepted by eng. Abd El Naser Abou Taleb, reviewed by eng. Hussein Kamal, 
revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El Bana & approved by eng. Ibrahem Hasan Talkha 750 
MW power 
station head sector, and certified by eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil MIPS coordinator of 
MDEPC approved by eng. Mohamed Naguib inspection and quality 
control head sector.

Combustion 
Chamber Technical 
Data
غرفة الاحتراق الحلقي
24 hybrid burners
2-flam detector

Walk in combustion chamber (two manholes up & down 
) for inspection

552 ceramic tiles (253 tiles at the hub - 300 tiles 
at outer shell)
Gas mass flow rate 15 kg/s at 100 % load
Fuel oil mass flow rate 18 kg/s at 100% load

Temperature degree 1230 
C at 100% load

sections.text: العمل الذي يتعين القيام به
Dismantling

Remove the isolation around the combustion chamber 
manholes

Dismantle the upper and lower combustion chamber 
manholes
Open air intake system
Open the exhaust system manhole

items:

Open air intake system
Open the exhaust system manhole

sections.text:
Inspection and Repair
Combustion Chamber Inspection

Inspect all tiles by using template to detrain the 
defective tiles (broken - cracks - erosion ) and replace it if required.

Visual inspection of the burners for (cracks - over 
heating & deposit).
Visual inspection of first row of vans.

Periscope inspection of first row of vans if 
required for (cracks - over heating).

Measure the radial clearance. Of the first row of 
vans.

sections.text: Air Intake System Inspection

Replace coalescer filters and self cleaning 
 filters at ∆P= 16 mb
Check the cleaning of blonum champer
Check the cleaning of inlet gaid van's (I.G.V)

Measure inlet gaid vans angle at the opening case 
 (6→7)

Measure the radial clearance of the fist row 
 of the compressor

Exhaust 
System Inspection

Check the exhaust system for any cracks and 
 damage
Measure the radial clearance of last row of vans

Visual inspection of turbine bearing no. 2 area 
 for leakage oil

sections.text: Chang of Ceramic Tiles

Dismantle the metallic tiles (use as locking for 
 ceramic tiles rows)

Star to dismantle the ceramic tiles by remove two 
 "Free support holders"

Move the ceramic tiles to be free from the other 
 two "Fixed support holders"

Dismantle the "Fixed holders" from their slots 
 and check the holders for cracks and change the fix bolts for the holders
